title: Inmarsat Aero: P channel 10.5 kbit/s (A-QPSK) from the satellite
description: A synthetic GES's P channel at 10 500 bit/s, carrier +400 Hz off the VFO centre, arriving from 75 deg (the satellite: one transmitter, no talker). System table broadcasts, then a log-on confirm for AES 4CA2B1, an ACARS uplink to EI-ABC (label H1, 'METAR UPDATE FOLLOWS') and a C channel assignment, repeated. Expect the Channel fact 'P channel 10500 bit/s A-QPSK', every signal unit passing its CRC, those events, and the VFO's DoA (Digital squelch) at 75 deg.

title: Inmarsat Aero: P channel 600 bit/s (A-BPSK) from the satellite
description: A synthetic GES's 600 bit/s P channel (frames of 2 s), carrier -1200 Hz off the VFO centre, from 220 deg. Acquisition takes a few seconds (the squared spectrum's lines at 600 Hz spacing), then system tables, a log-on confirm for AES C0FFEE and an ACARS uplink to C-GABC ('CLEARED AS FILED'). Expect 'P channel 600 bit/s A-BPSK', the events and the VFO's DoA at 220 deg.

title: Inmarsat Aero: R / T bursts from three aircraft (1.2 kbit/s, 1.6 GHz)
description: Aircraft transmissions received directly (L-band uplink, 1645 MHz), the plugin in its 'R / T bursts' mode: AES 4CA2B1 (EI-ABC, 40 deg, carrier +300 Hz) sends an R channel log-on request and, in a T burst, an ADS-C report (flight EIN123) near the station; C0FFEE (C-GABC, 165 deg, -500 Hz) an ACARS downlink ('FUEL 0123') and a log-on request; A1B2C3 (VH-XYZ, 290 deg, +900 Hz) an ADS-C report (QFA001). The bursts don't overlap. Each burst names its AES (24-bit ICAO address): expect talkers 4CA2B1, C0FFEE, A1B2C3 at those bearings and two aircraft on the map. Array radius 6 cm (0.39 wavelengths between neighbours at 1.6 GHz).

title: Inmarsat Aero: C channel 8.4 kbit/s (voice) - framing and signalling
description: A synthetic to-aircraft C channel (8 400 bit/s A-QPSK, carrier -600 Hz) from 130 deg: unique words, the rate 2/3 code, 25 voice frames and three sub-band signal units per 500 ms frame, a call progress for AES 4CA2B1 every 2 s. The voice fields are random bits (no AMBE encoder is available to make speech): with the user's Aero AMBE library installed, Listen plays codec noise; without it the Voice codec fact says 'not installed'. Expect 'C channel 8400 bit/s', the call progress events and the VFO's DoA at 130 deg.
